claim: L8 (LFP-primary analysis spec): magnitude-squared coherence and phase, all area x layer node pairs, per band, stim vs omission separately. Standard coherence reported alongside imaginary coherency per spec's own instruction (standard is inflated by volume conduction, imaginary is not).
implementation: context/figures/L8_cross_area_coherence/L8_cross_area_coherence.py. Reuses jnwb.spectral.imaginary_coherency verbatim for coh_mag_mean (standard) and icoh_mean/icoh_abs_mean (imaginary). Band-mean phase computed locally from the same Welch/CSD estimator (a quantity imaginary_coherency already computes internally but does not expose). One representative channel per (area, layer) node -- same limitation L6 already states for area-level channels, extended to node granularity. Node inventory rediscovered fresh against raw NWB files (not imported from L7) because coherence needs raw/complex signal, not L7's precomputed power arrays.
self_test: Spec's own explicit acceptance test: synthetic zero-lag common-source signal -> coh_mag=0.830 (high, as required), icoh_abs=0.022 (near-zero, as required) -- PASS. Genuinely lagged common source -> coh_mag=0.813, icoh_abs=0.794 (both high) -- PASS. Independent noise -> coh_mag=0.013 (low) -- PASS. Determinism also PASS.
bug_1_node_key_collision: sub-V182o_ses-260702 genuinely records FEF on two different probes (A and B). A bare f'{area}{layer}' node key produced indistinguishable duplicate labels in the first real run (nodes printed as ['FEFsup','FEFdeep','FEFsup','FEFdeep','MTsup','MTdeep'] with no way to tell which probe each entry came from -- matrix rows/columns were NOT lost here since L8 iterates a list not a dict, unlike the same bug in L7, but the labels were ambiguous and unusable). Fixed by making every node key probe-qualified (f'{area}{layer}_{probe}'), always. Rerun confirms distinct labels: FEFsup_A, FEFdeep_A, FEFsup_B, FEFdeep_B. The same latent pattern was found to be WORSE in L7 (silent data loss via dict-overwrite, not just ambiguous labels) -- L7 was fixed and rerun too; see context/figures/L7_cross_area_power_correlation/README.md and its evidence node for the corrected L7 account.
bug_2_figure_layout: First real-data render's suptitle string was too wide for the figure at the given fontsize and rendered centered OUTSIDE the canvas on both edges (start and end of the sentence both visibly truncated). Fixed by wrapping into three explicit shorter lines and adjusting subplots_adjust top/bottom margins; re-rendered and re-verified.

real_run.runtime: 1m26s initial + 1m41s node-key-fix rerun + fast rerun after the title-layout fix (numeric results unchanged by the title fix, only the node labels changed by the key fix -- underlying per-node-pair r/icoh values were already computed against the correct, distinct channels even before the key fix, since L8 iterates node list positions not dict keys)
sessions: sub-V182o_ses-260702 (6 nodes: FEF sup+deep on BOTH probes A and B, plus MT sup+deep)
real_run.finding_1: Every same-probe (same-letter-suffix) node pair, in all three sessions, alpha band checked in detail: high standard coherence (coh_mag 0.56-0.89) alongside near-zero imaginary coherency (icoh_abs 0.02-0.10) -- gap 0.31-0.82. Exactly the spec's own stated 'conducted, not interacting' signature. Fully consistent with L6 (zero-lag coupling fraction) and L7 (trial-level power correlation) independently flagging the same same-probe-adjacent-depth pairs as reference/volume-conduction-dominated -- three independent statistics agree.
real_run.finding_2: Cross-probe pairs are mostly low on both measures (coh_mag 0.01-0.15) EXCEPT sub-V182o_ses-260715's PFC<->FEF cross-probe pairs, which show elevated standard coherence (0.43-0.47) with still-low imaginary coherency (0.07-0.12) -- a smaller but real gap (0.31-0.40). This is the SAME session L7 already flagged as an outlier (13-15/15 node pairs FDR-significant in every band) -- cross-validated here via an independent statistic.
real_run.finding_3_discrepancy: For sub-V182o_ses-260702's FEF-A<->FEF-B pair specifically: L8 finds LOW standard coherence (0.08-0.13) and low imaginary coherency, but L7 (after its own node-key fix) finds this pair's TRIAL-LEVEL POWER strongly correlated. The two statistics disagree for the same pair/session -- flagged as an open cross-metric discrepancy in both L7 and L8's READMEs, not resolved or explained away here (trial-power correlation and phase coherence are genuinely different quantities; a shared slow state signal could drive one without the other).
real_run.reported_honestly: All findings reported descriptively per the spec's own 'do not conclude' instruction (0.8) and CLAUDE.md tripwire 10 -- no claim about genuine vs conducted coupling asserted in code.

not_yet_done: Single representative channel per node, not node-averaged or channel-resolved. Only 3 sessions, all V182o (single-subject result for this run, not planned). Broadband bands checked in the figure only for alpha; all 5 house bands are in the stats JSON but not individually visualized. The L7-vs-L8 FEF-A/FEF-B discrepancy is flagged, not investigated further.
